### [Introducing Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber](https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-gemini-3-5-flash-cyber/)

**Google DeepMind** · 2026-07-17

Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a new lightweight cybersecurity model designed to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.

- Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber is a lightweight model.
- Its primary function is to find cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
- It is also designed to patch identified vulnerabilities.

**Why it matters:** This model offers a new tool for automated cybersecurity defense by both detecting and fixing security flaws.

### [A scorecard for the AI age](https://openai.com/index/a-scorecard-for-the-ai-age)

**OpenAI** · 2026-07-17

OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar introduces an AI scorecard to measure ROI using metrics like useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

- The scorecard measures ROI through useful work.
- It evaluates cost per successful task.
- Dependability is a key metric.
- Return on compute is included in the assessment.

**Why it matters:** This scorecard provides a structured approach for organizations to quantify the value and efficiency of their AI investments.
